api.reason: A-as: a React component cannot be passed to an element. Client-side routing goes through tct-link-provider (linkContext.navigate), which every tct-link, tct-button and tct-avatar in its subtree consults; the anchor stays a native <a href>.

api.notes: aria-label of the inner element; a host aria-label wins.
Without it a <button type=button> renders. A destination the URL policy refuses renders an anchor without href.
Boolean attribute or a file name; the property is true or the file name.
The native click, retargeted from the inner anchor or button; a disabled link never fires it.
Built-in hover and focus tooltip through TooltipController (shadow mode), above the link.
Forwarded to the wrapping tct-text (truncation with a tooltip of the full text).
Forwarded to the wrapping tct-text; use inherit for an inline link inside a paragraph.

api.reason: A-xstyle family: data-* attributes are set on the host directly; nothing to map.
A-xstyle: use class/style, ::part(base|text|external-icon|tooltip) or the tokens.

hooks.notes: href wins; otherwise a container's request (Popover and menu triggers) or a missing href renders a button; a disabled destination renders a plain anchor without href.

keyboard.when: a live link or the button form

differences.text: Tecton links are body-coloured and the underline (on hover, or always with has-underline) is the only affordance: color=accent (the default) resolves to the primary text colour with no hover tint, as the owner's React theme re-points --color-text-accent for Link. primary and secondary keep upstream's 15% hover tint. The inner tct-text inherits the link colour so text, underline and icon always agree.

The router is not a component prop: tct-link-provider provides linkContext.navigate(href, event). A plain primary click on a same-origin link (not external, targeted, download or modified) is offered to it; returning true cancels the native navigation. Everything else stays native.
In forced colours the link takes LinkText (GrayText when disabled) instead of its palette colour, and the disabled dimming is dropped there.
With a tooltip active a host aria-describedby is not mirrored onto the inner control (tct-button does the same): the tooltip owns the description.

core.link.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessible-web-components] native a/button in the shadow root with delegatesFocus; [mwg:security] URL policy and noopener; [mwg:interest-triggered-tooltips] and [mwg:position-aware-tooltips] via TooltipController; [mwg:css] forced colours, hover only under (hover: hover). Utilities: useLinkify is the module function linkify() (linkify.ts); useLinkComponent is replaced by linkContext (tct-link-provider).
